notes: TugQL cross-database source conformance vectors, shared by dal-go/dalgo (Go) and dal-go/dalgo-js (TypeScript). Both implementations must satisfy every case; yaml and text must match byte for byte.

Text form: an optional root `databases (` block, before `parameters`, declares one alias per line as `alias` or `alias = '<target>'`. A FROM or JOIN source is qualified as `alias::path`, with `::` touching both sides. `::` is one lexer symbol.

An alias is an unquoted word that is not a reserved keyword; aliases are unique case-insensitively; a qualifier must name a declared alias exactly. A target is a non-empty single-quoted string, opaque to DALgo, printed single-quoted with `'` doubled.
textCases: ParseTugQL(text) has no diagnostics; expected.tree is the TugQTree JSON, expected.yaml is TugQLToYAML(text), expected.text is PrintTugQL(tree).

errorCases: ParseTugQL(text) fails; expected is the code and 1-based start line and column of the FIRST diagnostic. Database-use diagnostics (unused_database, undeclared_database) are reported in source order.

treeCases: a caller-built TugQTree passed to ResolveTugQL (operation resolve, with document source metadata tugql/1 and context.authorizedSchemas) or PrintTugQL (operation print). expected.code is the first diagnostic code (span 1:1); otherwise expected.query is the Serialize YAML of the resolved query or expected.text the printed text. A tree with no declarations keeps its legacy meaning for resolution (the caller binds every database by name); printing always requires declarations.
yamlCases: YAMLToTugQL(yaml); expected.code is the first diagnostic code, otherwise expected.text.

resolveCases: ResolveTugQL(ParseTugQL(text), context overlaid with the case's context); expected.code is the first diagnostic code, otherwise query (Serialize YAML), schemaVersion and column names. A join between sources of different databases (unqualified = the default database) with an omitted ON is cross_database_relationship; relationship metadata relates only sources of one database. An imported saved query that declares databases is nested_databases.

formatCases: FormatTugQL({source: text, sourceMetadata: tugql/1}, options) returns expected.text with no diagnostics. The `databases (` header word follows the keyword case; elsewhere `databases` is an ordinary identifier.
